rules.reason: Blob hash equals the blob at the same path on origin/main; nothing to land.

Branch-era state/decision/lesson logs; main's core logs carry the U1/U2 history and are authoritative. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.
Generated file; it is regenerated on main by tools/build_document_registry.py, never merged.
Per-commit change records of the retired record-per-commit process; kept on the branch ref as history, not landed.

Change record number already used on main with other content. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.
Recorded S2/S3/S4/S5 run outputs, reviews and snapshots bound to old heads; history only, not product behavior.

Evidence file at a path where main holds different content, for example the docs/sdlc/evidence/qa lane outputs. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.
S2/S3/S4 design and plan documents outside U3 scope; kept as design reference.

Plan/design/state document changed on both sides since the merge-base with different content. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.

Read: S3, S4 and S5 plan documents edited on the branch with status narrative of the old branch (S4 'implemented, acceptance open', REJECT dispositions, continuation notes) that describes the older docs/qa/categories.json registry and tools/qa/build_registry.py; main's S4 was accepted separately with a different registry, so landing would add contradictory status text. Not a code asset and no U3 scope.
Generated HTML status snapshots that do not exist on main; regenerable artifacts, not landed.

Read: the S0/S1, status and baseline HTML reports were re-stamped on the branch (the Git line now reads 's4-canonical-continuation @ 4e0deef') plus blank-line padding. Main did not change them, but landing would put a stale branch name and hash into main's reports; generated artifacts are regenerated, not merged.
Branch-era fixture/seeded-failure/API inventory data bound to the old registry schema and old test selectors; main keeps its own catalog in tests/qa/seeded_failure/catalog.json. Reference only.

Old categories registry (small, old schema) versus main's schema 2 registry at the same path. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.

Trusted PASS-line emitter and its parser test. The parser test needs the quiet-dot change in tools/vst/contracts.py, which conflicts with main and alters a hash-pinned parser; main already has a no-skip verdict in tools/qa/gate_check.py. Re-derive in U3-5 if needed.

Hash-bound seeded-failure fixture validator and tests built on the branch registry; main has its own accepted seeded-failure catalog and tests. Compatibility with main's registry is unproven, so conservative class.
Exact-head platform-matrix report validator against the branch registry and report formats; unproven against main's report envelope, so conservative class.
WSL snapshot transfer, root harness and requirements.in for the WSL runtime path; runtime-bootstrap scope, not U3.

Older branch implementation of modules main already ships and has accepted (registry, runner, report, plugin, dependencies, WSL scripts). Landing it would silently duplicate or regress main's tools/qa. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.
Tests for the old branch runner, registry and worker; they target code that is not landed.
S2/S3/S5 tests for unlanded VST changes; outside U3 scope.

Branch edits of S2/S3 VST tests matching the branch's own tools/vst changes. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.
Worker capability-drop helper and S5 source-tree code; S2/S3/S5 scope, not U3.

Branch edits of VST runner/store/gate/pilot/dispatch/supervisor modules where main also changed the file since the merge-base. S2/S3/S5 scope; resolving needs a manual three-way merge in a VST sprint, not U3. Main and the branch both changed this path since the merge-base (or both added it) with different content; copying it would overwrite main's version or conflict, and the branch edit is not rebased onto main.

Read: identical edit in s4-native-qa-runner and s4-e2e-snapshot (+80/-4). Adds require_no_extended_acl and stricter ancestor/ACL checks for the signer IPC path (POSIX hardening of the VST worker sandbox). Main did not change the file, so it applies cleanly, but it is S2/S3 sandbox security code outside the U3 testing-core scope and unverifiable here without POSIX tests (none were run); it does not touch tools/qa. Candidate for a separate VST hardening item, not U3.
